dataset: Credit Card Fraud Detection (ULB Machine Learning Group)
source: OpenML data id 1597 (creditcard), raw ARFF file_id 1673544 downloaded directly; OpenML marks Time as the row_id attribute so sklearn.fetch_openml drops it, the ARFF keeps it
original_publication: Dal Pozzolo, A., Caelen, O., Johnson, R. A. & Bontempi, G. (2015). Calibrating probability with undersampling for unbalanced classification. IEEE SSCI.
licence: Public (as stated on OpenML); originally released on Kaggle under the Open Database License (ODbL)
note: Two days of European card transactions, September 2013. Features V1-V28 are PCA-transformed for confidentiality; Time is seconds from the first transaction and is used only for the chronological split.
